name: LinkedIn Recruiter
description: LinkedIn Recruiter is a talent-sourcing and recruiting platform built on LinkedIn's professional network. Recruiting teams use it to search prospects, coordinate candidate activity, exchange InMail, and connect Recruiter workflows with approved applicant-tracking and candidate-relationship systems.
agentUseSummary: LinkedIn Recruiter cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its Recruiter System Connect and CRM Connect APIs are restricted to approved ATS or recruiting-CRM partners and require a business-development agreement, customer-specific applications, complete historical hiring-data synchronization, ACL mirroring, embedded plugins, staged certification, and a production key issued only after certification. Relay must first decide whether it will operate as an eligible ATS or recruiting CRM and accept those data and product duties.

blocked.label: Connect LinkedIn Recruiter
blocked.description: LinkedIn does not offer Recruiter System Connect or CRM Connect as a self-service generic account API; Relay must first qualify and contract as an ATS or recruiting-CRM partner.

blocked.label: Read Recruiter prospects
blocked.description: Member profiles, prospect matches, InMail history, notes, searches, projects, seats, contracts, and Recruiter activity remain unavailable before approved product access and customer enablement.

blocked.label: Synchronize recruiting data
blocked.description: Jobs, candidates, applications, stages, notes, interview feedback, deletions, ACLs, user-role associations, and historical bulk data cannot be sent to or retrieved from LinkedIn without an approved ATS contract.

blocked.label: Use Recruiter exports or plugins
blocked.description: One-click export, profile plugins, In-ATS and In-CRM indicators, customer onboarding, callbacks, and embedded Recruiter experiences require LinkedIn-issued artifacts and certification.

blocked.label: Act on candidates
blocked.description: Contacting, messaging, ranking, filtering, recommending, rejecting, advancing, scoring, exporting, or making employment decisions about candidates is blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw LinkedIn Recruiter interfaces
blocked.description: Private APIs, arbitrary Rest.li calls, browser automation, scraping, cookie or credential capture, raw profile export, ACL bypass, and cross-customer token reuse are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No LinkedIn Recruiter action is enabled until Relay selects an eligible ATS or CRM role, LinkedIn approves the partnership, and the complete data, ACL, plugin, customer-onboarding, certification, and deletion contract is implemented.

runtimeSupport.description: LinkedIn Recruiter APIs require an approved ATS or recruiting-CRM partnership and certified customer integration before any OpenClaw tool can be mounted.
LinkedIn Recruiter APIs require an approved ATS or recruiting-CRM partnership and certified customer integration before any Hermes tool can be mounted.

providerSetup.blocker: Recruiter System Connect is not a delegated API for an ordinary LinkedIn Recruiter account. LinkedIn limits Talent Solutions APIs to approved programs and prioritizes integrations that add value to existing Recruiter and Jobs customers. RSC requires an ATS to create customer-specific applications, host configuration and profile plugins, bulk-sync all historical and ongoing jobs, candidates, applications, notes, stages and ACLs, retrieve Recruiter interactions, preserve customer and seat attribution, handle deletions and push events, and demonstrate six certification modules before LinkedIn provisions a production key. CRM Connect instead requires Relay to be a recruiting CRM and has a different export and activity model. Choosing either is a material product, privacy, employment, support, and business-development commitment.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, legal, privacy, employment-compliance, security, and operations owners must decide whether Relay will become an ATS or recruiting CRM partner and define the customer, recruiter, candidate, purpose, data-controller and processor roles, lawful basis, fair-hiring restrictions, human oversight, retention, deletion, audit, support, SLA, and commercial model. Only after that decision may the provider-console owner apply to LinkedIn Talent Solutions. Implementation must cover every mandatory sync, customer-specific app and token isolation, exact ACLs, plugins, push events, historical backfill, deletions, certification tests, approval-gated candidate and communication actions, and post-disable denial before publication.

evidence.supports: LinkedIn documents distinct Apply Connect, Apply with LinkedIn, Job Posting, CRM Connect, and Recruiter System Connect products for ATS and recruiting applications.
LinkedIn requires a Talent Solutions partner application, prioritizes integrations for existing Recruiter and Jobs customers, and does not promise a formal agreement to every applicant.
LinkedIn directs talent integrations into restricted partner programs including Recruiter System Connect, Apply Connect, Apply with LinkedIn, and Premium Job Posting.
RSC requires bulk and ongoing synchronization of jobs, candidates, applications, notes, stages and ACLs between an ATS and LinkedIn, including historical records and deletions.
LinkedIn partners create customer-specific applications, host an ATS configuration plugin, store customer app keys, configure integrations, and wait for customer enablement.
LinkedIn requires certification across configuration, sync, retrieval, ACL, deletion, and other modules before provisioning a production API key.
CRM Connect is a separate approved recruiting-CRM partner product with profile export, embedded profile views, and CRM activity shown in LinkedIn Recruiter.
